notes.title: Dirt Bike Mini Racer completely free for everyone to enjoy
notes.content:
[p][b]Dirt Bike Mini Racer – Fun and Exciting Racing for Everyone [/b]
Get ready for an [b]action-packed racing adventure[/b] that’s fun for players of all ages! [i]Dirt Bike Mini Racer[/i] combines vibrant visuals, simple controls, and thrilling gameplay to deliver an engaging and accessible racing experience. Whether you're pulling off stunts, unlocking cool vehicles, or using dynamic special powers, this game guarantees hours of fast-paced fun in a colorful and lively world.
[/p]

notes.title: Dirt Bike Mini Racer completely free for everyone to enjoy
notes.content:
We have some exciting news to share! Starting March 20, we will be making Dirt Bike Mini Racer completely free for everyone to enjoy. Please buy our other games if you want to support us. This decision comes from our desire to grow our community, make the game more accessible, and ensure more players can experience what we've built.

We truly appreciate everyone who has supported us by purchasing the game. As a thank you, existing players.

If you have any questions, feel free to ask. We can’t wait to welcome more players to our world!

To ensure a smooth transition, we are giving everyone a week’s notice before the game officially becomes free on March 20. This way, players who recently purchased the game are informed, and we can address any concerns before the switch happens. 

Please buy our other games if you want to support us.
